newsitem.title: GERMANY: Demand/intermodal links are refocus of travel conference.
newsitem.headline: Demand/intermodal links are refocus of travel conference.

text.p: Demand trends for air travel, passenger strategies for airlines and airports, and intermodal linking of rail and air transport are the main themes of a passenger travel conference in Frankfurt next month.
The 5th Frankfurt Passenger Symposium from February 4-5 will focus on client orientation for airlines and airports, a Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) statement said.

Speakers will include Gerd Hesselmann, president of the German travel agents association DRV, Heinz Duerr, Deutsche Bahn AG chairman, and Dieter Kaden, of the German air traffic control authority Deutsche Flugsicherung.
Representatives of the European Commission, the European Parliament, the German transport ministry and airlines will also give presentations, FAG said.
The conference will be held at the Sheraton Hotel, Frankfurt Airport. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
